t = Row,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 20),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 102, 0, 10),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = song.Name,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 15,
            TextColor3 = spotifyText,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 102, 0, 31),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = song.Artist,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local Heart = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -126, 0.5, -18),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 45,
        })
        mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Heart,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = FavPage.HEART_ON,
            ImageColor3 = spotifyGreen,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            ZIndex = 46,
        })
        mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 58),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = song.Duration,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })

        local row = {Index = index, Row = Row, Title = Title, Number = Number, Bars = Bars, BarList = bars, HoverIcon = HoverIcon, Heart = Heart}
        FavPage.rows[#FavPage.rows + 1] = row
        Row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            row.Hover = true
            Row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
            FavPage.paintRow(row)
        end)
        Row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            row.Hover = false
            Row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            FavPage.paintRow(row)
        end)
        FavPage.paintRow(row)

        bindRowTap(Heart, function()
            toggleTrackLike(index)
        end)
        bindRowTap(Row, function()
            FavPage.toggleRow(index)
        end)
    end

    FavPage.rebuild = function()
        for _, child in ipairs(FavPage.Body:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                safeDestroy(child)
            end
        end
        FavPage.rows = {}
        local list = FavPage.likedList()
        local query = normalizeSearchText(FavPage.query or "")
        local shown = 0
        for position, index in ipairs(list) do
            local song = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            local ok = query == ""
            if not ok and song then
                ok = normalizeSearchText((song.Name or "") .. " " .. (song.Artist or "")):find(query, 1, true) ~= nil
            end
            if ok then
                shown = shown + 1
                FavPage.makeRow(index, position)
            end
        end
        if #list == 0 or shown == 0 then
            local box = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = FavPage.Body,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 170),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                ZIndex = 42,
            })
            mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = box,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 24),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = #list == 0 and FavPage.HEART_OFF or FavPage.SEARCH,
                ImageColor3 = spotifyDim,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 43,
            })
            local t1 = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = box,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 80),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 18,
                TextColor3 = spotifyText,
                ZIndex = 43,
            })
            local t2 = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = box,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 110),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 13,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextColor3 = spotifyDim,
                ZIndex = 43,
            })
            if #list == 0 then
                FavPage.text(t1, "Las canciones que te gusten aparecerán acá", "Songs you like will appear here")
                FavPage.text(t2, "Tocá el corazón de cualquier canción para guardarla.", "Save songs by tapping the heart icon.")
            else
                FavPage.text(t1, "No se encontraron resultados", "No results found")
                FavPage.text(t2, "Probá con otro nombre o artista.", "Try another name or artist.")
            end
        end
        FavPage.PlayAll.Visible = #list > 0
        FavPage.ShuffleBtn.Visible = #list > 0
        local es = (#list == 1) and "1 canción" or (tostring(#list) .. " canciones")
        local en = (#list == 1) and "1 song" or (tostring(#list) .. " songs")
        if #list > 0 then
            local tes, ten = FavPage.totalText(list)
            es = es .. ", aprox. " .. tes
            en = en .. ", about " .. ten
        end
        FavPage.text(FavPage.Count, "• " .. es, "• " .. en)
        FavPage.signature = table.concat(list, ",") .. "|" .. query
        FavPage.paint()
    end

    FavPage.refresh = function()
        if not FavPage.open then
            return
        end
        local sig = table.concat(FavPage.likedList(), ",") .. "|" .. normalizeSearchText(FavPage.query or "")
        if sig ~= FavPage.signature then
            FavPage.rebuild()
        else
            FavPage.paint()
        end
    end

    FavPage.SearchInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        FavPage.query = FavPage.SearchInput.Text or ""
        FavPage.refresh()
    end)

    FavPage.animate = function()
        task.spawn(function()
            while FavPage.open and FavPage.Root.Parent do
                if SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                    for _, row in ipairs(FavPage.rows) do
                        if row.Bars.Visible then
                            for _, bar in ipairs(row.BarList) do
                                FavPage.tween(bar, 0.18, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, math.random(25, 100) / 100, 0)})
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
    end

    FavPage.show = function()
        if FavPage.open then
            return
        end
        FavPage.open = true
        SongsCard.Visible = false -- el catálogo no debe verse detrás de favoritos
        FavPage.layout()
        FavPage.rebuild()
        FavPage.Scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        FavPage.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
        FavPage.Root.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(FavPage.Root, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()
        task.defer(FavPage.layout)
        FavPage.animate()
    end

    FavPage.hide = function()
        if not FavPage.open then
            return
        end
        FavPage.open = false
        SongsCard.Visible = true
        pcall(function() FavPage.SearchInput:ReleaseFocus() end)
        local tw = TweenService:Create(FavPage.Root, TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)})
        tw.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not FavPage.open then
                FavPage.Root.Visible = false
            end
        end)
        tw:Play()
    end

    FavPage.playAll = function()
        local list = FavPage.likedList()
        if #list == 0 then
            return
        end
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound and isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex) then
            SpotifyState.FavQueue = true
            togglePlayback()
        elseif SpotifyState.Shuffle then
            FavPage.play(FavPage.randomFrom(list, nil))
        else
            FavPage.play(list[1])
        end
    end

    bindRowTap(FavPage.Back, FavPage.hide)
    bindRowTap(FavPage.PlayAll, FavPage.playAll)
    bindRowTap(FavPage.MiniPlay, FavPage.playAll)
    bindRowTap(FavPage.ShuffleBtn, function()
        SpotifyState.Shuffle = not SpotifyState.Shuffle
        FavPage.history = {}
        FavPage.paint()
    end)

    SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged = FavPage.refresh
    SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor = FavPage.neighbor

    createSongRow = function(track, index, layoutOrder)
        if SpotifyState.HiddenRows[index] then
            return
        end

        local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
        local cardH = m.cardHeight
        local coverPad = m.compact and 9 or 11
        local availableW = math.max(0, spotifyLogicalSize(SongList).X - ((m.gridColumns - 1) * m.gridGapX) - 8)
        local cellW = math.max(90, math.floor(availableW / m.gridColumns))
        local coverSize = math.max(42, cellW - 20)
        coverSize = math.floor(math.min(coverSize, m.coverMax))

        local Row = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = SongList,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize + 20), cardH),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.22,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = layoutOrder or (index + 1),
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 11,
        })
        Row.Name = "SpotifySongCard_" .. index
        corner(Row, 12)
        stroke(Row, Color3.fromRGB(95, 95, 100), 1, 0.78)

        local TapArea = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 13,
        })
        TapArea.Name = "SongTapArea"

        local Accent = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = spotifyGreen, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = index == SpotifyState.SelectedIndex, ZIndex = 14,
        })
        corner(Accent, 999)

        local Cover = mk("ImageButton", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(coverSize, coverSize),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(coverSize / 2), 0, coverPad),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Image = resolveTrackCoverImage(track),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 15,
        })
        corner(Cover, 9)

        local Title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 20),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, coverPad + coverSize + 9),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = track.Name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = m.compact and 12 or 14, TextColor3 = index == SpotifyState.SelectedIndex and spotifyGreen or spotifyText,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextWrapped = true, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 16,
        })
        Title.Name = "SongTitle"

        local Artist = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, coverPad + coverSize + 31),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = track.Artist, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = m.compact and 9 or 10, TextColor3 = index == SpotifyState.SelectedIndex and Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 120) or spotifyDim,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 12,
        })
        Artist.Name = "SongArtist"

        local Duration = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, -22),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = track.Duration, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 9,
            TextColor3 = spotifyDim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 12,
        })
        Duration.Name = "SongDuration"

        local Plus = mk("ImageButton", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -7, 1, -5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "",
            ImageColor3 = spotifyText, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 16, Active = true, Visible = false,
        })
        Plus.Name = "SongPlus"

        local Play = mk("ImageButton", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, coverPad + coverSize - 4), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0, Image = asset(135609604299893), ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 17, Active = true,
        })
        Play.Name = "SongPlay"
        corner(Play, 999)

        bindRowTap(TapArea, function() SpotifyState.FavQueue = false playTrack(index) end)
        Cover.Activated:Connect(function()
            SpotifyState.FavQueue = false
            playTrack(index)
        end)

        local _plusFired = false
        local _playFired = false
        local function fireLike()
            if _plusFired then return end
            _plusFired = true
            toggleTrackLike(index)
            task.defer(function() _plusFired = false end)
        end
        local function firePlay()
            if _playFired then return end
            _playFired = true
            SpotifyState.FavQueue = false
            playTrack(index)
            task.defer(function() _playFired = false end)
        end
        Plus.Activated:Connect(fireLike)
        Play.Activated:Connect(firePlay)

        SpotifyState.RowButtons[index] = {
            Row = Row, Accent = Accent, Cover = Cover, Title = Title, Artist = Artist,
            Duration = Duration, Plus = Plus, Play = Play, TapArea = TapArea,
        }

        applySpotifyRowLayout(SpotifyState.RowButtons[index])
        updateTrackRow(SpotifyState.RowButtons[index], index)
        return Row
    end
clearSongRows = function()
        for _, child in ipairs(SongList:GetChildren()) do
            if child ~= SongListLayout and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
                safeDestroy(child)
            end
        end
        SpotifyState.RowButtons = {}
        SpotifyState._FavoritesTile = nil
        SpotifyState._MySongsTile = nil
        updateSongListCanvas()
    end

    local function renderCatalog(catalog)
        clearSongRows()
        SPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)

        SpotifyState.Catalog = {}
        for i, track in ipairs(catalog or {}) do
            local normalized = normalizeTrack(track, i)
            if normalized then
                normalized.IsUserSong = false
                table.insert(SpotifyState.Catalog, normalized)
            end
        end

        SpotifyState.UserSongs = {}
        for _, track in ipairs(loadUserSongs()) do
            if type(track) == "table"
                and type(track.Name) == "string"
                and type(track.Artist) == "string"
                and type(track.AudioURL) == "string"
                and isDirectMp3Url(track.AudioURL) then
                local preparedTrack = table.clone(track)
                preparedTrack.AudioURL = normalizeDownloadUrl(preparedTrack.AudioURL)
                if type(preparedTrack.CoverURL) == "string" then
                    preparedTrack.CoverURL = normalizeDownloadUrl(preparedTrack.CoverURL)
                end
                local normalized = normalizeTrack(preparedTrack, #SpotifyState.Catalog + 1)
                if normalized then
                    normalized.IsUserSong = true
                    table.insert(SpotifyState.UserSongs, normalized)
                    table.insert(SpotifyState.Catalog, normalized)
                end
            end
        end

        if #SpotifyState.Catalog == 0 then
            -- Spotify no muestra estado del catálogo en la vista visual.
            PlayerSongTitle.Text = GetText("Catálogo vacío", "Empty catalog")
            PlayerSongArtist.Text = GetText("Revisa el repositorio remoto", "Check the remote repository")
            PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Sin canciones disponibles", "No songs available")
            AlbumArt.Image = ""
            ProgressTimeLeft.Text = "0:00"
            ProgressTimeRight.Text = "0:00"
            ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            syncPlaybackUI()
            return
        end

        -- Spotify no muestra el contador del catálogo en la vista visual.
        loadSpotifyFavorites()
        renderSongRows()
        updateSongListCanvas()
        updateSpotifyCanvas()

        local order = getRenderOrder()
        selectTrack(order[1] or 1)
        updateProgress(SpotifyState.Catalog[1], SpotifyState.CurrentSound)
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function loadCatalogFromRemote()
        destroyAllSpotifySounds()
        local catalogData = nil

        local okRemote, remoteResult = pcall(function()
            local raw = game:HttpGet(SPOTIFY_CATALOG_URL, true)
            local loader = loadstring(raw)
            if not loader then
                error("loadstring_failed")
            end
            return loader()
        end)

        if okRemote and type(remoteResult) == "table" then
            if type(remoteResult.Catalog) == "table" then
                catalogData = remoteResult.Catalog
            elseif type(remoteResult.catalog) == "table" then
                catalogData = remoteResult.catalog
            else
                catalogData = remoteResult
            end
        else
            warn("[Spotify] No se pudo cargar el catálogo remoto: " .. tostring(remoteResult))
        end

        if type(catalogData) ~= "table" then
            catalogData = {}
        end

        SpotifyState.CatalogLoaded = true
        renderCatalog(catalogData)
        updateSpotifyCanvas()
    end

    do
        local staticTranslations = {
            ["Favoritos"] = "Favorites",
            ["Tus canciones favoritas"] = "Your favorite songs",
            ["Ajustes de reproducción"] = "Playback settings",
            ["El catálogo se carga desde GitHub"] = "The catalog loads from GitHub",
        }
        for _, element in ipairs(SpotifyShell:GetDescendants()) do
            if element:IsA("TextLabel") or element:IsA("TextButton") then
                local english = staticTranslations[element.Text]
                if english then
                    element:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", element.Text)
                    element:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", english)
                    element.Text = GetText(element.Text, english)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.insert(YLang.Listeners, function()
        local titleSpanish, titleEnglish = "Selecciona una canción", "Select a song"
        if PlayerSongTitle.Text == titleSpanish or PlayerSongTitle.Text == titleEnglish then
            PlayerSongTitle.Text = GetText(titleSpanish, titleEnglish)
        end
        local artistSpanish, artistEnglish = "El catálogo se carga desde GitHub", "The catalog loads from GitHub"
        if PlayerSongArtist.Text == artistSpanish or PlayerSongArtist.Text == artistEnglish then
            PlayerSongArtist.Text = GetText(artistSpanish, artistEnglish)
        end
        local metaPairs = {
            {"Esperando canción", "Waiting for a song"},
            {"Pausado por el temporizador", "Paused by sleep timer"},
            {"Reproducción pausada", "Playback paused"},
            {"Reproducción activa", "Playback active"},
        }
        for _, pair in ipairs(metaPairs) do
            if PlayerMeta.Text == pair[1] or PlayerMeta.Text == pair[2] then
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText(pair[1], pair[2])
                break
            end
        end
        if FP.Title and (FP.Title.Text == titleSpanish or FP.Title.Text == titleEnglish) then
            FP.Title.Text = GetText(titleSpanish, titleEnglish)
        end
    end)

    SpotifyPages:JumpTo(PlayerPage)
    refreshSpotifyCatalogMode()
    syncPlaybackUI()
    pcall(refreshSpotifyUILayout)
    updateSongListCanvas()
    updateSpotifyCanvas()
    task.defer(function()
        pcall(updateSongListCanvas)
        pcall(updateSpotifyCanvas)
    end)
    task.spawn(loadCatalogFromRemote)

    RepeatBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        SpotifyState.IsRepeat = not SpotifyState.IsRepeat
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            pcall(function()
                SpotifyState.CurrentSound.Looped = SpotifyState.IsRepeat
                if SpotifyState.IsRepeat and SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition > 0 then
                    local len = SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimeLength
                    if len > 0 and (len - SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) < 0.5 then
                        SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition = 0
                        SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Play()
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end)

    LikeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        toggleTrackLike(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
    end)

    PlayPauseBtnOuter.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or
           input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            PlayPauseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Fire()
        end
    end)

    PlayPauseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            if SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
                pcall(function()
                    SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0)
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Pause()
                end)
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Reproducción pausada", "Playback paused")
            else
                SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
                pcall(function()
                    if SpotifyState.CurrentSound and SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition and SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition > 0 then
                        SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition = math.max(0, SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition)
                    end
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Play()
                    task.defer(function()
                        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound and SpotifyState.IsPlaying and SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition and SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition > 0 then
                            pcall(function()
                                SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition = math.max(0, SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition)
                            end)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Reproducción activa", "Playback active")
            end
            syncPlaybackUI()
            return
        end

        if SpotifyState.Catalog[SpotifyState.SelectedIndex] then
            playTrack(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        end
    end)

    PrevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(previousTrack)

    NextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if #SpotifyState.Catalog == 0 then
            return
        end

        local nextIndex = SpotifyState.SelectedIndex + 1
        if nextIndex > #SpotifyState.Catalog then
            nextIndex = 1
        end
        playTrack(nextIndex)
    end)

    MoreBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        PlayerMeta.Text = "Menú de opciones abierto"
    end)
    end

    function Window:CreateFanArtTab()
        local TabFanArt = Window:CreateTab("Fan Art", "Fan Art", "rbxassetid://91504176503119")
        local FanArtPage = TabFanArt.Page

        local FanArt_Items = {
            { name = "YYFanArt1.png", url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yinyangGPX/Beta/main/file_000000001704820a8cdf28c046004a14.png" },
        }

        local fanArtExecutorOk = type(game.HttpGet) == "function"
            and type(writefile) == "function"
            and type(isfile) == "function"
            and type(getcustomasset) == "function"

        local function fanArtLooksLikeImage(data)
            if type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 10 then return false end
            return data:sub(1, 4) == "\137PNG" or data:sub(1, 3) == "\255\216\255"
        end

        local FA = {}

        -- Cabecera de la galeria
        FA.hero = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FanArtPage,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 74),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 9,
        })
        FA.hero:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        corner(FA.hero, 16)
        stroke(FA.hero, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.55)
        local heroIcon = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FA.hero, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -23),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.8, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        heroIcon:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(heroIcon, 14)
        RowKit.Icon(heroIcon, 118538685614420, 24, 11, "Accent")
        local heroTitle = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FA.hero, Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "Fan Art", TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 20,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        heroTitle:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        local heroSub = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FA.hero, Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText("Arte de la comunidad de Yin Yang", "Art from the Yin Yang community"), TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        heroSub:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
        heroSub:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Arte de la comunidad de Yin Yang")
        heroSub:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Art from the Yin Yang community")
        local countES = #FanArt_Items .. (#FanArt_Items == 1 and " obra" or " obras")
        local countEN = #FanArt_Items .. (#FanArt_Items == 1 and " piece" or " pieces")
        local heroCount = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FA.hero, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.8,
            Text = GetText(countES, countEN), TextColor3 = Theme.Accent, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 11, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        heroCount:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        heroCount:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")
        heroCount:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", countES)
        heroCount:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", countEN)
        heroCount:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        corner(heroCount, 999)
        mk("UIPadding", {Parent = heroCount, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)})

        -- Visor a pantalla completa (se crea una sola vez)
        FA.viewer = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Main,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Active = true,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 400,
        })
        corner(FA.viewer, 10)
        FA.viewerImage = mk("ImageButton", {
            Parent = FA.viewer, Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, -90), Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 50),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 401,
        })
        corner(FA.viewerImage, 10)
        FA.viewerTitle = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FA.viewer, Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 16,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 402,
        })
        FA.viewerTitle:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        FA.viewerHint = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FA.viewer, Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -32), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText("Tocá la imagen para acercar / alejar", "Tap the image to zoom in / out"), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 11, ZIndex = 402,
        })
        FA.viewerHint:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Tocá la imagen para acercar / alejar")
        FA.viewerHint:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Tap the image to zoom in / out")
        FA.viewerHint:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        FA.viewerClose = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = FA.viewer, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 8),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 46), Text = "×", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 20, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 403,
        })
        corner(FA.viewerClose, 999)
        FA.viewerScale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = FA.viewerImage, Scale = 1})
        FA.viewerClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.45)
            FA.viewer.Visible = false
        end)
        FA.viewerImage.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local zoomed = FA.viewerImage.ScaleType == Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            FA.viewerImage.ScaleType = zoomed and Enum.ScaleType.Crop or Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            FA.viewerScale.Scale = 0.96
            TweenService:Create(FA.viewerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
        end)
        function FA.open(image, titleText)
            FA.viewerImage.Image = image
            FA.viewerImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            FA.viewerTitle.Text = titleText
            FA.viewer.Visible = true
            FA.viewer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TweenService:Create(FA.viewer, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.12}):Play()
            FA.viewerScale.Scale = 0.9
            TweenService:Create(FA.viewerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
        end

        for artIndex, art in ipairs(FanArt_Items) do
            local Card = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = FanArtPage,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 320),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                ZIndex = 9,
            })
            corner(Card, 16)
            local cardStroke = stroke(Card, Theme.Accent, 1.5, 0.45)
            cardStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")

            local Ambient = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = Card,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = "",
                ImageTransparency = 0.78,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
                ZIndex = 9,
            })
            corner(Ambient, 16)

            local Skeleton = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Card,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -70),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 46),
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 10,
            })
            corner(Skeleton, 12)
            local shimmer = mk("UIGradient", {
                Parent = Skeleton,
                Rotation = 20,
                Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0),
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.6),
                }),
            })
            local shimmerTween = TweenService:Create(shimmer, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false), {Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)})
            shimmerTween:Play()

            local ArtImage = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = Card,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -70),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = "",
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Visible = false,
                ZIndex = 11,
            })
            corner(ArtImage, 12)

            local ArtStatus = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Card,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -70),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText("Cargando imagen...", "Loading image..."),
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 225),
                TextSize = 13,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextWrapped = true,
                ZIndex = 12,
            })
            ArtStatus:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Cargando imagen...")
            ArtStatus:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Loading image...")
            ArtStatus:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)

            local bar = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Card,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 40),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -50),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 12,
            })
            corner(bar, 12)
            local artTitle = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = bar, Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "Fan Art #" .. artIndex, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 13,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 13,
            })
            artTitle:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            local viewBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = bar, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, Text = GetText("Ver en grande", "View large"), TextColor3 = Theme.AccentText,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 11, AutoButtonColor = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = 13,
            })
            viewBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            viewBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "AccentText")
            viewBtn:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Ver en grande")
            viewBtn:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "View large")
            mk("UIPadding", {Parent = viewBtn, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 18)})
            RowKit.IconAt(viewBtn, 100435796827759, 13, UDim2.new(0, -6, 0.5, -6), 14, "AccentText")
            viewBtn:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            corner(viewBtn, 999)
            RowKit.Control(viewBtn, true)
            viewBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                FA.open(ArtImage.Image, artTitle.Text)
            end)

            local function setArtStatus(es, en)
                ArtStatus.Text = GetText(es, en)
                ArtStatus:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
                ArtStatus:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                if not fanArtExecutorOk then
                    shimmerTween:Cancel()
                    setArtStatus("Tu ejecutor no soporta la descarga de imágenes", "Your executor does not support image downloads")
                    return
                end

                local assetId = nil
                pcall(function()
                    local needDownload = true
                    local cachedOk, cachedExists = pcall(isfile, art.name)
                    if cachedOk and cachedExists then
                        needDownload = false
                        if type(readfile) == "function" then
                            local readOk, cachedData = pcall(readfile, art.name)
                            if not (readOk and fanArtLooksLikeImage(cachedData)) then
                                needDownload = true
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if needDownload then
                        local dlOk, data = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, art.url, true)
                        if not dlOk or not fanArtLooksLikeImage(data) then return end
                        local writeOk = pcall(writefile, art.name, data)
                        if not writeOk then return end
                    end

                    local assetOk, result = pcall(getcustomasset, art.name)
                    if assetOk and type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then
                        assetId = result
                    end
                end)

                shimmerTween:Cancel()
                if assetId then
                    ArtImage.Image = assetId
                    Ambient.Image = assetId
                    ArtImage.Visible = true
                    ArtStatus.Visible = false
                    Skeleton.Visible = false
                    viewBtn.Visible = true
                else
                    setArtStatus("No se pudo cargar la imagen", "Could not load the image")
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    Window:CreateFanArtTab()

    return Window

end


print(" Yin Yang v24 CON TEMA CAT V1  - ¡Librería cargada y lista para usar!")


local _ZeroAI = (function()
    local Players     = game:GetService("Players")
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local StarterGui  = game:GetService("StarterGui")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not LocalPlayer then return end

    local AI_BACKEND_URL = "https://yin-chat.onrender.com"
    local PLAYER_NAME = LocalPlayer.Name

    local SYSTEM_PROMPT = [[
Eres Zero, una IA integrada dentro de la librería UI llamada Yin Yang, específicamente dentro del script EVADE v5.2 Beta para el juego Roblox "Evade".

Estás sirviendo al jugador ]] .. PLAYER_NAME .. [[, quien es el desarrollador del script.

SOBRE QUIÉN ERES:
- Tu nombre es Zero
- Eres parte de la librería Yin Yang UI v28
- Fuiste diseñada para asistir a quien usa el script EVADE v5.2 Beta
- Hablas de forma directa, casual y concisa — nunca eres robótica ni formal
- Eres inteligente, sabes exactamente lo que hace cada opción del script

CONOCIMIENTO COMPLETO DEL SCRIPT EVADE v5.2 Beta:

PESTAÑA MOVEMENT:
1. Teleport Walk (FloatingToggle)
   - Mueve al jugador hacia adelante teletransportándolo en lugar de caminar normalmente
   - Velocidad ajustable con slider de 1 a 50
   - Se desactiva automáticamente si se activa Jump Frontal

2. Enhanced Jump (FloatingToggle)
   - Aumenta la altura del salto modificando JumpPower y UseJumpPower en el Humanoid
   - Altura ajustable con slider de 20 a 300
   - Se desactiva automáticamente si se activa Jump Frontal

3. Auto Jump (FloatingToggle)
   - Hace que el jugador salte automáticamente cuando está corriendo (estado Running)
   - Cambia el HumanoidState a Jumping cada Heartbeat

4. Jump Frontal - Beta (FloatingToggle)
   - Sistema de movimiento frontal complejo que propulsa al jugador hacia adelante
   - Al activarse: desactiva Teleport Walk, Enhanced Jump y Gravity Mod para evitar conflictos
   - Al desactivarse: restaura las opciones que estaban activas antes
   - Usa BodyVelocity con MaxForce (4e5, 4e5, 4e5) para el impulso
   - Raycast frontal (lookDir * 8-10) para detectar estructuras y rampas adelante
   - En el suelo: saltos cada 0.65 segundos con aceleración suave
   - En el aire: si detecta estructura aplica impulso con componente vertical (impactForce * 1.2)
   - Variables globales: getgenv().FrontalJumpSpeed (defecto 42), getgenv().RampMultiplier (defecto 1.55)
   - Speed Movement: slider 50-110
   - Ramp Multiplier: slider 1.0-5.0

5. Gravity Mod (FloatingToggle)
   - Reduce el efecto de la gravedad en el jugador
   - Gravity Scale: slider 0.1-2

PESTAÑA MAP FEATURES:
6. FullBright (FloatingToggle)
   - Ilumina completamente el mapa modificando propiedades de Lighting
   - Restaura la iluminación original al desactivarse

7. Auto Ticket (FloatingToggle)
   - Teleporta automáticamente al jugador a los tickets/coleccionables del mapa
   - Usa getgc(true) para encontrar CollectableIDs en memoria

SOBRE LA LIBRERÍA YIN YANG v28:
- Librería UI custom para Roblox con FloatingToggles, Sliders, Labels, Dividers y Tabs
- Los FloatingToggles son ventanas flotantes arrastrables
- Bug crítico ya corregido: pcall(cb, state) en el click de la pill flotante

REGLAS DE RESPUESTA:
- Máximo 2 oraciones por respuesta — apareces en el chat del juego
- Habla en español siempre, de forma casual
- Si no sabes algo con certeza, dilo — no inventes
]]

    local history = {
        { role = "system", content = SYSTEM_PROMPT }
    }
    local waiting = false

    local function chatMsg(text, color)
        pcall(function()
            StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {
                Text     = text,
                Color    = color or Color3.fromRGB(140, 120, 255),
                Font     = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 14,
            })
        end)
    end

    local function ask(userText)
        if waiting then
            chatMsg("[⚡ Zero]: Espera, ya estoy procesando algo...", Color3.fromRGB(160, 140, 255))
            return
        end
        waiting = true

        table.insert(history, { role = "user", content = userText })

        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, reply, aiName = pcall(function()
                local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ messages = history })

                local aiRequest = (syn and syn.request)
                    or (http and http.request)
                    or fluxus_request
                    or http_request
                    or request

                if not aiRequest then
                    error("No HTTP request function available")
                end

                local res = aiRequest({
                    Url     = AI_BACKEND_URL .. "/api/ai/chat",
                    Method  = "POST",
                    Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
                    Body    = body,
                })

                if not res or res.Success == false then
                    error("Backend AI unavailable")
                end

                local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(res.Body)
                if not data.success or not data.reply then
                    error(data.error or "AI returned no response")
                end

                return data.reply, data.name or "Yin AI"
            end)

            waiting = false

            if ok and reply then
                table.insert(history, { role = "assistant", content = reply })
                chatMsg("[" .. tostring(aiName or "Yin AI") .. "]: " .. reply, Color3.fromRGB(140, 1
